stages.handoff:
Syslog configuration now has a public [`syslog.Conf`](/app/config/syslog/types.go) with validation in its own package. Config and the reporter use that type, while `config.SyslogConf` remains an alias for existing callers. Enabled syslog retains the existing field validation behavior; Windows returns the specified unsupported error.

Tests passed for `./config/syslog`, `./config`, and `./reporter`. The Windows syslog tests cross compiled successfully, and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed `tctl auth sign --format=kubernetes` to use an HTTPS Kubernetes proxy address on port 3026. The new `ProxyConfig.KubeAddr()` uses the first Kubernetes public address, or the first generic public address as a fallback, and errors when Kubernetes proxy support is disabled. When the local Kubernetes proxy is unavailable, `tctl` checks registered proxies, skips invalid addresses, and errors if none are usable. An explicit `--proxy` still takes precedence.

Added regression tests. `go test -vet=off ./lib/service ./tool/tctl/common -count=1` and `git diff --check` pass.

Added `timeOffset` support through the public and Subsonic stream handlers, streaming interfaces, transcoding cache, and FFmpeg command generation. Missing, invalid, or negative HTTP values default to 0; custom FFmpeg commands without `%t` gain `-ss` only for a nonzero offset. Updated the OpenSubsonic extension response, mocks, and tests.

The affected Go package tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Resolved the PassAliases drawer issue. The drawer now shows all available aliases or an explicit “No aliases” state, and “Get an alias” opens the creation modal. The provider now handles users without a vault and creates one when the creation flow needs it; the bridge separates vault lookup from creation.

Verification passed: the PassAliases tests, type checks for components and Pass, and formatting and diff checks.

Moved Qt wrapper initialization into early startup and passed its `SelectionInfo` to the availability checker. Implicit initialization now reports failed wrapper imports through `NoWrapperAvailableError`; diagnostics, debug logging, and checker message spacing are clearer.

Verification: 42 focused tests and 19 startup tests passed. The full version test run stopped during its real Chromium check; the affected version-info tests passed separately.

Implemented the generic fanout buffer in [buffer.go](/app/lib/utils/fanoutbuffer/buffer.go). It supports ordered concurrent cursors, overflow storage with grace period expiry, blocking and nonblocking reads, and cleanup on cursor or buffer closure.

Added focused tests in [buffer_test.go](/app/lib/utils/fanoutbuffer/buffer_test.go). `go test -race ./lib/utils/fanoutbuffer` passes.

Updated the [WinRM connection plugin](/app/lib/ansible/plugins/connection/winrm.py) to accept `ansible_winrm_kinit_args` and split command and argument strings into separate tokens. When `kinit_args` is set, it takes precedence over the default delegation `-f` flag. Both subprocess and pexpect use the same constructed command line.

Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/plugins/connection/test_winrm.py) for argument parsing, delegation precedence, invocation count, and unique credential caches. All 36 WinRM unit tests pass.

Added a 10-second cache in [useLink.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_links/useLink.ts) for `NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_ALLOWED`, and `INVALID_ID` fetch errors. Repeated requests for the same share and link reuse the error until it expires; other links and successful fetches proceed normally.

Added coverage in [useLink.test.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_links/useLink.test.ts). All 17 focused tests passed. ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` also passed.

Session renaming is implemented for both the current session and other sessions. The new [DeviceDetailHeading](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetailHeading.tsx) provides a 100-character input, Save and Cancel actions, a saving indicator, and the required error message. Successful saves update the visible name immediately.

All 52 relevant tests pass, and lint passes. Type checking is still blocked by three errors in the installed `matrix-js-sdk` dependency concerning `IRequest.abort`; it reports none in the changed files.

Updated the message composer so replaced-room notices use paragraphs and clearly state that the room is no longer active. Added a reusable, accessible `CancelButton` for the reply preview and search bar; the reply preview now names the sender, including for emote replies. Profile components can render as a `span` where the heading needs inline markup.

The relevant tests passed (7 total), as did ESLint and Stylelint. TypeScript still reports errors in unchanged SDK and room alias code.

Implemented the repository fixes for `_UNSET` handling, module parameter and traceback errors, legacy YAML constructors, `None` templar overrides, lookup messages, deprecation display, Boolean `timedout` results, and early CLI errors. Added focused regression tests.

Verification: **367 passed, 1 skipped**; `git diff --check` passed. The separate legacy module deprecation tests still have seven controller-mode fixture failures: they expect target-side warning storage but receive controller display output.

Fixed XHR header handling. `custom_headers` now accepts `fallback_accept_language=True`; for XHR requests, the interceptor disables the global Accept-Language fallback while preserving domain-specific overrides. Other requests retain the global setting.

The focused tests passed: **29 passed**.

Updated [DocCLI.tty_ify](/app/lib/ansible/cli/doc.py) to render `L()`, `R()`, and `HORIZONTALLINE`, handle multiple macros on one line, and preserve ordinary text such as `IBM(International Business Machines)`. The existing `I()`, `B()`, `M()`, `U()`, and `C()` output patterns remain covered.

Added focused tests in [test_doc.py](/app/test/units/cli/test_doc.py). All 30 relevant unit tests passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Resolved the notification dropdown race and trigger handling, and updated quick search, topic modals, database hash fields, post routes, email formatting, installation guards, and the affected templates.

Validation passed: ESLint, `git diff --check`, and 102 existing tests across the hash, email, and notification suites. The pre-existing untracked `appendonlydir/` was left untouched.

QR sign-in is now controlled by the experimental `feature_qr_signin_reciprocate_show` setting, which defaults to disabled. The QR section appears in either settings tab only when the flag is enabled and the homeserver supports MSC3882 and MSC3886. The existing “Show QR code” action still opens the QR login view.

All 60 relevant tests pass, and the edited files pass ESLint and Prettier. Full type checking is blocked by an existing error in the untouched [RoomView test](/app/test/components/structures/RoomView-test.tsx:178).

Implemented host-scoped monitoring jobs. `OlAsyncIOScheduler` now registers jobs only when `HOSTNAME` matches an allowed exact name or prefix wildcard, and registered jobs default to the function name as their ID. I also added the HAProxy metric collector and async monitoring entrypoint.

Verification: all 8 monitoring tests pass, Ruff passes, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Added SQL Server connection testing to the database diagnostic flow. The new [SQLServerPinger](/app/lib/client/conntest/database/sqlserver.go) validates connection parameters, respects the context deadline, and classifies refused connections, login failures, and invalid database errors. The [protocol selector](/app/lib/client/conntest/database.go) now returns it for SQL Server and continues to reject unsupported protocols.

Focused tests pass: `GOPROXY=off go test ./lib/client/conntest/database ./lib/client/conntest`.

Updated configuration decoding so scalar strings destined for `[]string` fields split on whitespace. Repeated, leading, and trailing whitespace is ignored; an empty string produces an empty slice. Existing sequences and other value types remain unchanged.

The CORS fixture now verifies `foo.com bar.com  baz.com` through both YAML and ENV loading. Empty-string decoding is also covered. `go test ./internal/config` and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated `Roles.Check` to reject unknown and duplicate roles, and `Roles.Equals` to compare distinct role sets regardless of order or repeated entries. Nil and empty lists compare equal. Added regression cases in [roles_test.go](/app/lib/utils/roles_test.go).

The focused role suite passes. The full `lib/utils` suite has one unrelated failure: a certificate fixture expired in 2021, so its error no longer matches the test’s expectation.

Implemented Redis cache TLS support in the checked-out repository. `RedisCacheConfig` now accepts `ca_cert_path`, `ca_cert_bytes`, and `insecure_skip_tls`; conflicting CA settings fail validation with the required error. The server uses the new `redis.NewClient`, which requires TLS 1.2 when TLS is enabled.

Added YAML fixtures, client tests, and the `api/cachetls` integration case and GitHub Actions matrix entry. Local Go tests passed for `internal/config`, `internal/cache/redis`, `internal/cmd`, and `build/testing`. The Dagger integration case compiled but was not run locally.

Updated the List and Seed models with explicit types, shared `SeedDict` typing, normalized key based membership checks, subject key helpers, and filtered export data. Added focused tests for seed formats, subject normalization, and exports.

Validation passed: 17 tests, mypy on the model and plugin, Ruff, and `git diff --check`. The legacy `test_listapi.py` suite could not collect because this environment lacks `cookielib`.

Updated the RPM scanner so an unparseable `SOURCERPM` adds a warning and skips only the source package; the binary package remains available and the scan continues. Epoch-prefixed source filenames now produce the correct source name and version, linked to the binary package.

Added regression tests and verified with `go test ./scanner -count=1`.

Updated authentication startup to open a database only when an enabled method requires one. JWT is marked as database free; static token, OIDC, GitHub, and Kubernetes require a database. Cleanup now runs only for enabled, database backed methods.

Verified with the existing `internal/config`, `internal/cmd`, and `internal/cleanup` tests. A new startup test also confirms JWT works with Local, Git, and object storage while the database URL is invalid.

Updated author matching in `/app`. It now compares extracted birth and death years across date formats, tries exact names before alternate names and surname matches, and handles literal asterisks in names. Honorific removal accepts a string, preserves the listed name exceptions and honorific-only names, and new author records retain the input fields. Regression tests cover these cases.

Verification: the add-book suite finished with **160 passed, 1 expected failure**. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

YAML values that exactly match `${VARIABLE_NAME}` now resolve from the environment during parsing, before the other decode hooks convert values such as ports and durations. Existing `FLIPT_...` overrides still take precedence; unmatched values remain unchanged.

Added coverage for multiple references, type conversion, override precedence, and invalid or missing references. `go test ./internal/config ./config -count=1` passed.

Updated the checked-out repository so Ubuntu reports consider both Ubuntu CVE sources. The new `GetCveContentTypes` mapping is used for change detection, source URLs, field ordering, titles, and summaries. CVSS v3 retrieval now includes the additional sources, and `NEGLIGIBLE` maps to the low severity range.

Added regression tests. `go test ./models ./detector ./reporter` and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated Proton Drive’s persisted session lookup to return `number | null`, accept only numeric `ps-` keys, preserve the valid ID `0`, and leave localStorage untouched. The public bookmark hook now resumes a session only when an ID exists, restoring its saved key password before listing bookmarks.

The two relevant Jest suites passed: 17 tests total. `git diff --check` also passed.

Added `getCachedChildrenCount(shareId, parentLinkId)` to [useLinksListing.tsx](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/links/useLinksListing.tsx). It returns the length of the cached children array, including children that have not been decrypted.

Tests cover counts before fetching, after one page, after the full load, and for other shares and parents. Both relevant Jest suites passed: 8 tests.

Added [nios_fixed_address.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/net_tools/nios/nios_fixed_address.py) to manage IPv4 and IPv6 DHCP fixed addresses, including DHCP options, metadata, deletion, and check mode. Updated the [NIOS API helper](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/net_tools/nios/api.py) with fixed address types and identity-based lookup.

The focused tests cover creation, idempotence, updates, deletion, and check mode. All 58 NIOS unit tests pass.

Updated the AIX hardware facts collector to report `processor_count` as 1, count available processor devices as cores, default threads per core to 1, derive vCPUs, and return the CPU type as a list. Added tests for reported SMT threads, missing SMT data, and no available processors.

Verification: all 18 hardware facts unit tests passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed the default-config path. `config.Load("")` now applies `FLIPT_` environment overrides to defaults, and startup calls the loader even when no config file is found. File values still form the base when a path is provided.

Added regression tests for `FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL`, `FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT`, and file precedence. `go test ./internal/config ./cmd/flipt` passes.

Updated [async_wrapper.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/async_wrapper.py) to use a single JSON termination routine, write job records atomically, and include consistent job IDs and lifecycle fields. Fork, setup, and timeout failures now produce structured errors; timeout records include the child PID. Cleanup follows the configured policy.

Expanded [test_async_wrapper.py](/app/test/units/modules/test_async_wrapper.py) to cover atomic replacement, failure paths, normal completion, and timeout. All 6 tests pass.

U2F sign requests now include a challenge for every registered U2F device, while retaining the legacy single-challenge fields. The CLI can use any challenge in the list, and the auth client still accepts older single-challenge responses. Web endpoints pass through the enhanced payload.

A two-token web login regression passed, as did the auth, client, and web test suites. The checkout contains compiled web assets but no web UI source for changing MFA device management visibility.

Updated the IA metadata importer to put ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 values in separate lists and split `Place: Publisher` entries into `publish_places` and `publishers`. The public helpers are in [utils.py](/app/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/utils.py). Empty or unusable values are omitted, and the raw `isbn` and `publisher` fields are no longer emitted.

The affected tests pass: **26 passed**. `git diff --check` also passes.

Introduced `Evaluator` and moved SQL evaluation into [storage/evaluator.go](/app/storage/evaluator.go). [Server.Evaluate](/app/server/evaluator.go) now delegates through that dependency; `RuleStore` handles rule storage only.

The evaluator applies rank ordered rules, typed constraints, and deterministic variant selection. I updated the existing tests and added coverage for rank precedence, rollout boundaries, and 0% distributions. `go test ./storage ./server` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated the config loader to read the three database pool options and `meta.check_for_updates`. The update-check default is now `false`, so omitted keys retain `Default()` values; the default and deprecated fixtures still match it field for field. The advanced fixture tests explicit pool values and an enabled update flag.

`go test ./config`, `go test ./...`, and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed YAML dumping of `AnsibleUndefined`: it now raises the missing-variable error instead of a PyYAML representation error. Both YAML filters report which filter failed and preserve the original exception for inspection.

Added dumper, filter, and template regression tests. **Verification:** 64 relevant tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented transparent gzip decoding for HTTP responses in the shared URL utility, with a `decompress` option defaulting to `True` in `uri`, `get_url`, and the URL helper functions. Added `GzipDecodedReader`, preserved response metadata, and added the required missing-gzip deprecation behavior.

Verification: all 85 URL utility tests pass; modified modules compile; `git diff --check` passes.

Fixed `Booknotes.update_work_id` so a destination conflict leaves every booknote unchanged and returns `{"rows_changed": 0, "rows_deleted": 0, "failed_deletes": 1}`. Successful updates return the same three keys with the appropriate counts. I also updated the admin response to use that dictionary.

Added regression tests for conflicts, successful updates, and dry runs. All 5 tests in `openlibrary/tests/core/test_db.py` pass.

Removed `ListMixin` and moved its methods onto `List`. Owner lookup now accepts `/people/{username}/lists/{list_id}` and returns `None` when the key is invalid or the user is missing. The new [register_models](/app/openlibrary/core/lists/model.py) function registers `List` as `/type/list` and `ListChangeset` as `lists`.

The relevant run passed **27 tests**. One existing request context test was deselected; a separate legacy test module could not collect because `cookielib` is unavailable.

Added `GET /.well-known/webfinger` through the new [route](/app/src/routes/well-known.js) and [controller](/app/src/controllers/well-known.js). The handler validates the account resource, checks `view:users` for the requester or Guest, returns 400/403/404 as appropriate, and serves a WebFinger JSON response with both profile aliases and an HTML profile link.

The five focused tests pass. ESLint and `git diff --check` also pass. The database backed integration suite was not run because its setup reads and logs private configuration.

Tracing setup now lives in [internal/tracing/tracing.go](/app/internal/tracing/tracing.go). The gRPC server uses `NewProvider` and `GetExporter` and shuts down the provider before the exporter, allowing pending spans to flush. Isolated tests cover resource attributes, sampling, exporter selection, endpoints, and repeated shutdown.

Verification passed: `go test ./internal/tracing ./internal/cmd -count=1`.

Implemented the namespace access fix. Both authorization engines now evaluate viewable namespaces; the middleware passes the result to `ListNamespaces`, which filters the response and reports an accessible namespace count. The UI redirects a saved route for an inaccessible namespace to an accessible one.

`go test ./internal/server/authz/... ./internal/server -count=1` passed. UI checks could not run because dependencies are not installed locally.

Collection-name validation now rejects Python keywords in either segment and names that are not valid Python identifiers. Galaxy requirement parsing uses the same validator, and the legacy helpers and their Python 2/3 compatibility code have been removed from [dataclasses.py](/app/lib/ansible/galaxy/dependency_resolution/dataclasses.py).

Verification: 73 collection-loader tests and 17 targeted galaxy CLI tests passed.

Updated [module_common.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py) to resolve `module_utils` dependencies through a queue and separate legacy and collection locators. It now bundles redirect shims and missing package initializers, handles relative imports in package `__init__.py`, and reports attempted paths when resolution fails.

Added focused tests in [test_module_util_locators.py](/app/test/units/executor/module_common/test_module_util_locators.py). Verification: **52 module_common tests passed**.

Implemented deterministic per-ID seeding in [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go). `SetSeed` now produces repeatable hashes for the same input, reseeding changes the result, and restoring a seed restores the original result. Seed access is synchronized.

Added regression coverage in [hasher_test.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go). The hasher, database, and persistence tests pass; the hasher race test passes too.

Updated the repository so plugin removal and redirect failures carry resolution context. Added `get_with_context()` for callers that need the plugin instance and its metadata, centralized deprecation and removal message formatting, and updated the connection, action, and Jinja callers.

Relevant tests passed: **95 passed**. `git diff --check` also passed.

Implemented the email validation fix in the checked-out repository. Confirmations now use a user-to-code key and a timestamped confirmation object. Resends reject active confirmations unless forced; expired codes are rejected, and validation actions can recover an email from confirmation data when the profile has none. Confirmation keys are cleared after validation and account deletion. The ACP now shows **Validated**, **Validation Pending**, **Validation Expired**, or **(no email)**.

The focused confirmation, admin socket, and ACP status tests pass. Template compilation, ESLint, and `git diff --check` pass. The broader user and admin controller suites each still have one failure outside the tested validation flow: invitation group membership and an edit/email 404 assertion, respectively.

Updated the album, artist, and share models so unset timestamps can be read safely. The album `image_files` field now accepts NULL, addressing the reported scan error. Added the public `gg.P` and `gg.V` helpers and updated callers to use them.

The affected package tests and `git diff --check` pass. The full test suite still has four unrelated TagLib failures involving fixture metadata and an unreadable file check.

`tsh` now reads `TELEPORT_KUBE_CLUSTER` after parsing CLI arguments. It sets `KubernetesCluster` when no CLI cluster was specified; an explicit CLI value takes precedence.

The existing `TELEPORT_CLUSTER`/`TELEPORT_SITE` precedence and `TELEPORT_HOME` override already meet the requested behavior. I added tests for Kubernetes cluster precedence and the home override. The focused `tool/tsh` tests and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented token accounting for `Chat.Complete` and `Agent.PlanAndExecute`. Both now return a non-nil `*model.TokenCount`; the agent aggregates prompt and completion counts across steps, including streamed responses. Assist and web callers now use the returned count.

The model counter tests and `git diff --check` pass. Broader AI and Assist tests could not run because this environment lacks required HID and libc C headers; disabling CGO also breaks the HID dependency.

Updated `oval.major` to return `""` for zero-length input without changing how it parses non-empty versions. Added a regression case to the existing test.

The focused test and the full `./oval` test suite pass.

Added `singleton.GetInstance[T](constructor)` in [singleton.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton.go). It returns `T` directly, caches by exact type so `T` and `*T` are independent, and runs the constructor once per type under concurrent calls.

Added coverage for reuse and 20,000 concurrent calls in [singleton_test.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton_test.go). The package tests and race detector pass.

Updated the Trivy parser to store the OS release from `Metadata.OS.Name`, use `ArtifactName` as `ServerName`, add `:latest` to untagged container images, and leave `Optional` nil. Package CVE detection now skips the specified cases, and scanned CVE reuse identifies Trivy results through `ScannedBy`.

Updated the existing tests and added focused coverage. `go test ./contrib/trivy/parser/v2 ./detector` and `git diff --check` passed.

Added JXL MIME detection and enabled HEIC, HEIF, and JXL previews on macOS and iOS Safari 17+. Both upload parsers now use a specific `File.type` when available and fall back to the file extension, without reading file content.

All 10 tests in three relevant Jest suites pass. Both workspace type checks remain blocked by errors outside the edited files.

Implemented YAML-native variant attachments in `internal/ext` and connected the CLI import and export commands to it. Export renders stored JSON attachments as YAML structures; import converts YAML attachments to JSON strings and handles missing attachments. Flags, variants, segments, constraints, rules, and distributions remain in the document hierarchy.

Round-trip tests cover nested values and missing attachments. `go test ./internal/ext`, `go test ./storage/... ./cmd/flipt`, and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [PosthogAnalytics.ts](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts) to enforce configuration and DNT rules, use `Anonymity` consistently, gate and await event capture, hash user and room IDs, and reset the PostHog client on logout. Updated the [analytics tests](/app/test/PosthogAnalytics-test.ts) for the async lifecycle and privacy cases.

All 16 focused tests pass. The repository-wide TypeScript check still reports unrelated errors elsewhere.

Added the public [Dialog component](/app/packages/components/components/dialog/Dialog.tsx). It forwards attributes and the host ref, uses a native `<dialog>` when supported, and uses an accessible host in limited DOM environments. [ModalTwo](/app/packages/components/components/modalTwo/Modal.tsx) now uses it and marks the dialog open, so interactive children are discoverable by role.

Verification passed: 11 focused Jest tests, TypeScript, targeted ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Updated the author import system to match by Open Library key first, then external identifiers, then name and dates. It now merges new identifiers into matched authors, preserves them on new authors, raises a clear error for conflicting identifiers, and uses a consistent tie break when multiple authors match. I also added the `wikisource` suspect date exemption.

Verification: 125 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented the process-to-package lookup fix in `/app`. Debian and Red Hat `postScan` now use a shared `pkgPs` function that collects process file paths, looks up their owners, and associates each process once per package. Red Hat ownership lookup matches by package name, avoiding spurious warnings when RPM reports another installed architecture or version.

RPM ownership parsing now ignores lines ending in “Permission denied,” “is not owned by any package,” or “No such file or directory,” and returns an error for malformed lines. A regression test covers mixed versions and architectures.

Verification passed: `go test ./scan -count=1` and `git diff --check`.

Updated `ContextReader` to restore the terminal when a password read is canceled or closed. Canceled reads move to a clean state so later reads can proceed, and a timed-out password read returns an empty result with `context.DeadlineExceeded`. Added `NotifyExit` and called it when `tsh` finishes running.

`go test ./lib/utils/prompt` and `git diff --check` pass. The `tsh` compile check was stopped during extended dependency compilation; it produced no diagnostic.

Implemented `proxy_service.kube_listen_addr` in the checked-out repository. It enables the Kubernetes proxy, uses the Kubernetes default port when needed, and takes precedence over an explicitly disabled legacy block. An enabled legacy block combined with the shorthand now produces a clear conflict error.

The configuration warns when both Kubernetes and proxy services are enabled without an explicit Kubernetes proxy listen address. Client resolution replaces `0.0.0.0` or `::` with the web proxy host and continues to prefer configured public addresses.

Added focused configuration and client tests. `go test ./lib/config ./lib/client` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated `useMyCountry` to return a country code or `undefined`, and changed all seven consumers to use the single value. PhoneInput now starts with no country for an empty or undefined default and adopts the first eligible country supplied after mount.

The targeted Jest suites pass (15 tests). ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` also pass.

Added [transformStyleAttributes.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/transforms/transformStyleAttributes.ts) to replace inline `height` values containing `vh` with `auto`, including on the root element. Other inline styles are preserved. The [HTML preparation pipeline](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/transforms/transforms.ts) now runs it after `transformStylesheet` and before `transformRemote`.

The new test and the existing remote transform test passed: 5 tests total.

Added `scrolling.bar=overlay`. On non-macOS QtWebEngine with Qt 5.11 or newer, it adds `--enable-features=OverlayScrollbar`; elsewhere it uses the existing scrollbar behavior. Legacy `False` now migrates to `overlay`. I also updated the documentation, made Chromium flag tests independent of argument order, and added `@js_headers` handling for the affected Qt versions.

Verification: 319 configuration tests passed, 1 skipped, and 2 unrelated dark mode tests were deselected because one exits the test process in this environment. Both marked end-to-end header scenarios collected successfully.

Fixed the mail-details decryption path. Single and batch loads now carry supplied owner-encrypted session keys through the cache and apply them before decryption. Mail rendering, inbox rules, draft reply-to loading, and indexing now pass available mail keys.

Validation passed: TypeScript, 40 EntityRest tests, 29 MailIndexer tests, formatting, and `git diff --check`.

Implemented matcher expressions in [lib/utils/parse/parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go). `Match` now handles literals, wildcards, raw regular expressions, `regexp.match`, `regexp.not_match`, and static prefixes and suffixes. It validates malformed or unsupported expressions, and `Variable` rejects matcher functions.

Added coverage in [parse_test.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse_test.go). `go test ./lib/utils/parse` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated `format_languages` to resolve two-letter ISO codes and English or native language names to canonical MARC keys, then remove duplicates while preserving first occurrence. Added tests for the reported cases.

Verification: 132 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated `_parse_clixml` to decode UTF-16 escape sequences, combine valid surrogate pairs, preserve control characters and unpaired surrogates, and return only the requested stream. It now handles empty `<S>` elements and joins results from separate `<Objs>` blocks with `\r\n`.

Updated the existing tests. All 17 PowerShell shell tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Implemented IDN handling in the checked-out files. `punycodeUrl` converts the hostname to ASCII while preserving the other URL components and removing a trailing path slash. `useLinkHandler` applies it to external links and shows an error when a link has no extractable URL. The confirmation warning now recognizes Punycode after subdomains such as `www`.

Validation passed: 17 focused tests, the components typecheck, lint, formatting, and `git diff --check`.

Amazon imports now include language names from edition metadata when available. Serialization excludes entries marked `Original Language`, removes duplicates, preserves Amazon’s casing, and omits `languages` when the result is empty. The load cleanup also preserves the field.

Verification: all 37 vendor tests pass, and Ruff and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated [FnToCLI](/app/scripts/solr_builder/solr_builder/fn_to_cli.py) to parse `Path` and typed lists, accept explicit argument sequences, map `--<parameter_name>` options to their parameters, and return results from synchronous and asynchronous functions. Existing dashed option spellings still work.

Added regression coverage in [test_fn_to_cli.py](/app/scripts/solr_builder/tests/test_fn_to_cli.py). All 10 focused tests pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` pass.

Added a `user_props` table and a context-scoped `UserPropsRepository`. The migration transfers existing Last.fm session keys, and Last.fm now uses the `sessionKeyProperty` constant instead of constructing user-prefixed keys. Property error logs include the request ID when available.

Added a test for user isolation, updates, and deletion. `go test ./...` and `git diff --check` pass.

Address parsing is updated. `splitBySeparator` now returns ordered, trimmed tokens with angle brackets and empty entries removed. Both autocomplete components use it for pasted addresses, and `inputToRecipient` uses a bare bracketed email for both `Name` and `Address`.

Type checks and lint passed. The shared test suite passed 835 of 837 tests, including the new parsing tests; two unrelated tests failed on cookie expiry and empty-file base64 output.

Implemented date based module deprecations across Python and C#. `removed_at_date` and dated aliases now produce date entries in module output; Display shows the removal date, and validation checks date format and expired dates. The C# `DateTime` overload formats event log dates as `yyyy-MM-dd` and validates alias entries.

Added [icx_logging.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/network/icx/icx_logging.py) with aggregate and present/absent management for IPv4 and IPv6 syslog hosts, UDP ports, facilities, buffered levels, console, persistence, RFC5424, and global logging. It compares settings with the running configuration to avoid unnecessary commands and supports check mode.

Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/network/icx/test_icx_logging.py). The full ICX unit test group passed: **98 tests**.

Updated the Drive member view so members, internal invitations, and external invitations are stored and displayed by share ID. Writes to one share now leave other shares’ data intact. Added `getExistingEmails` and regression tests for share isolation.

The package type check and 8 relevant tests pass.

Updated Windows SSH stderr handling to replace valid CLIXML blocks with readable text while preserving surrounding bytes and malformed or incomplete blocks. The decoder uses UTF-8 with a cp437 fallback, and the UTF-16-BE escape matcher now leaves Unicode lookalikes unchanged.

The relevant tests pass: **48 passed**.

Added digest support across image configuration, scanning, scan results, and reporting. Validation now requires a name and exactly one of tag or digest. Image references use `name:tag` or `name@digest`, and local reports can be written for registry-qualified image names.

The config, scan, and report package tests pass with vet disabled; the focused model test passes. The full models suite still fails in the existing `TestScan`, and default vet flags existing conversions in `models/library.go`.

Implemented separate, iterative sanitizers in [basic.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py): `remove_values` masks sensitive substrings in string values without changing keys, while `sanitize_keys` masks mapping keys and honors exact ignored keys and `_ansible` keys. Updated [uri.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/uri.py) to sanitize response keys when `no_log_values` is set, and kept date serialization working when scalar dates pass through unchanged.

The 31 focused tests pass, as do syntax and diff checks. The broader basic suite still has failures caused by shared warning state between tests.

Added [mailMetricsHelper.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/metrics/mailMetricsHelper.ts) with `getLabelID` and `getPageSizeString`. Custom mailbox IDs become `"custom"`; built-in IDs stay unchanged. Page sizes become `"50"`, `"100"`, or `"200"`, with `"50"` as the fallback. The Mail manifest and lockfile now declare `@proton/metrics`.

Verification passed: 44 Jest tests, the Mail TypeScript check, ESLint, and Prettier.

Fixed the ZIP timestamp crash in [unarchive.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/unarchive.py:335). The new `_valid_time_stamp` method parses and validates ZIP dates, accepts years from 1980 through 2107, and uses the ZIP epoch for invalid values such as `19800000.000000`. `is_unarchived` now uses it.

Added regression coverage in [test_unarchive.py](/app/test/units/modules/test_unarchive.py:23). All 15 unarchive unit tests pass.

Added `parsePkgName` and connected it to CycloneDX PURL construction for library and GitHub dependency packages. It returns namespace, name, and subpath for the five requested ecosystems, with empty strings for fields that do not apply. Added regression tests.

`go test ./reporter/sbom` and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed Direct Dial SSH heartbeats that advertise wildcard or loopback hosts. Upstream streams now expose `PeerAddr()`, and the in-memory pipe accepts `ICSPipePeerAddr`. Before `UpsertNode`, the controller uses the peer’s host for those addresses while preserving the node’s original port.

The inventory tests pass, including the new address regression cases. The API module tests could not start because a dependency is unavailable locally and downloads are disabled.

Worksearch now requests Solr JSON by default and reads search results, facets, and spellcheck suggestions from JSON. The new facet functions handle value/count pairs, including author names and ordered `has_fulltext` values. I updated the existing tests for JSON documents and responses.

Verification: all 27 Worksearch tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean.

FormatString now accepts an optional `encoding` and rejects characters it cannot encode during `to_py`, with a validation error. The user agent setting requires ASCII; FormatString settings without an encoding constraint keep their existing behavior.

Verification: the config type and config data suites passed (1,139 passed, 10 expected failures).

Implemented separate database settings for SQLite, Postgres, and MySQL. `db.url` takes precedence when present; otherwise the application validates the discrete fields and builds the connection target with engine-specific port defaults. Connections and migrations now use the same configuration path and pool settings, and URL parsing and opening errors omit credentials. The sample config and focused tests were updated.

Verification passed: `GOPROXY=off go test ./config ./storage/db ./cmd/flipt` and `git diff --check`.

Updated the import flow in `/app`. YAML imports now use the v3 decoder, preserving nested metadata and attachments in JSON compatible structures. JSON imports accept one leading line that starts with `#`; files without a header still import normally. The import tests also verify that namespace key, name, and description are applied.

`GOPROXY=off go test ./internal/ext` and `git diff --check` pass. The CLI package check was stopped while compiling dependencies.

Implemented `.well-known` `force_disable` support for new rooms. The shared policy helper gives server force-enable settings precedence and warns when they conflict with `.well-known`. The room creation dialog keeps the encryption toggle disabled while the policy loads, shows any enforced value, and submits the value shown.

The focused tests passed (30 total), as did ESLint and Prettier for the changed files. The full TypeScript check still reports an unrelated error in [src/Unread.ts](/app/src/Unread.ts:167).

Fixed the vars file caching regression. `DataLoader.load_from_file` now supports `cache='none'` without adding a cache entry and `cache='vaulted'` to cache decrypted vault files. The variable manager uses vaulted caching for play vars files, avoiding repeated reads and decryption.

Added regression tests for both modes and cache reuse. All 42 relevant tests pass, and `git diff --check` passes.

Added an OCI `SnapshotSource` that fetches snapshots from local layouts or remote registries, reopens local layouts on each fetch, and polls for digest changes. Updated `SnapshotSource.Get` and its callers to accept a context. OCI layers now support namespace annotations, gzip encoding, and manifest creation timestamps.

The local refresh and subscription test passes. All tests in `./internal/oci` and `./internal/storage/fs/...` pass.

Added a member-scoped lock to the user info panel’s Kick, Ban, and Mute buttons. It blocks repeat activation immediately, sets both `disabled` and `aria-disabled="true"` on all three buttons, and clears when confirmation is canceled or the operation succeeds or fails. Failures show one error dialog.

The focused UserInfo suite passes all 71 tests, and ESLint passes. The repository-wide type check still reports existing errors outside the changed files; it reports none in these files.

Room search now combines adjacent results whose context timelines share an event. The merged tile shows that event once, highlights every direct match, and links each matched message to its original event ID. Results without an overlap remain separate.

Validation passed: 10 focused tests, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.

Edition matching now accepts raw records. The new `expand_record`, `add_db_name`, and `threshold_match` functions in [merge_marc.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/merge/merge_marc.py) generate title and ISBN comparison fields, handle missing author dates, and compare expanded records at the requested threshold. Existing `catalog.utils` imports remain available.

Regression tests cover raw records, matches without ISBNs, author/contributor names, and thresholds 875 and 515. **Verification:** 13 tests passed; 2 existing tests remain expected failures. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented `x-flipt-accept-server-version` handling in the [gRPC middleware](/app/internal/server/middleware/grpc/middleware.go). The new interceptor stores parsed versions in request context, accepts both `v1.0.0` and `1.0.0`, and falls back to `1.0.0` when the header is missing or invalid. It is registered in the [server interceptor chain](/app/internal/cmd/grpc.go).

Added focused tests. `go test ./internal/server/middleware/grpc ./internal/cmd` passed.

Updated `AffectedProcess` so legacy `listenPorts` string arrays parse successfully. Structured scan data now uses `ListenPortStats []PortStat`; scanning, reachability checks, and reports use the new field, while reports can still display legacy ports. Added `NewPortStat` and `HasReachablePort`.

Verification passed: `go test ./models ./scan ./report` and `git diff --check`.

Updated the database proxy to shuffle all matching services, retry the next candidate when a tunnel has a connection problem, and return a specific error when none can be reached. Authorization now retains every candidate, and tests can set a deterministic order and simulate offline tunnels.

`tsh db ls` now shows one entry per database name. Server logs include `HostID`, and sorting uses name then `HostID`.

The existing database proxy, reverse tunnel, and `tsh` tests passed, along with new tests for ordering, deduplication, offline fallback, and the all offline error.

Forked workers now send `Display.display` calls through `FinalQueue` as `DisplaySend` events. The parent results thread replays them under a display lock. I removed the worker’s shutdown redirection, made cleanup flush stdout and stderr, and kept the results reader active until workers have exited.

Verification: 8 focused tests passed, 7 existing strategy tests were skipped, and a forked-process smoke check passed. The existing warning tests still fail when run together because they share a singleton warning cache.

Implemented native SQLite backups in `/app`: `backup create`, `backup prune`, and `backup restore`, with confirmation for restore and for pruning when `backup.count` is zero. Added `conf.Server.Backup` settings, startup directory creation and schedule validation, periodic backup and pruning, and the `DB.Backup`, `DB.Restore`, and `DB.Prune` methods.

The full `go test ./...` suite passed. After a small confirmation input fix, the affected `cmd`, `db`, and `conf` tests passed again.

Updated [incdec_number](/app/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py) to skip digits in percent-encoded triplets, preserve encoded URL data, validate the operation and count, reject decrements below zero, and leave ports untouched. It now searches for the first valid number in path, query, anchor, then host order, following the issue’s final explicit match-order requirement.

Updated the [tests](/app/tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py) for that behavior. All 128 `TestIncDecNumber` tests pass. The broader `test_urlutils.py` run aborted during Qt application fixture startup after the affected tests had run.

Implemented the chat allow and deny lists, the incoming chat disable setting, and server side checks for chat initiation and room creation. Added an idempotent upgrade that seeds allow lists from follows for accounts that used `restrictChat`. Account settings, API schema, and tests are updated.

Verification passed: 78 messaging tests, 276 user tests, 3 federated private chat tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Added optional `ident` support to `password_hash` and both hashing backends. The password lookup now defaults to `2a` for bcrypt, stores the chosen ident beside the salt, and reuses it on later runs. Added documentation and tests.

**Verification:** 60 relevant tests passed. The crypt backend passes all four idents through, but this system’s `crypt` library rejects `2`; it can generate `2a`, `2y`, and `2b`.

RemoteCluster now persists its status and last heartbeat. When tunnel connections are read, a newer heartbeat is stored in UTC; removing a newer connection cannot move it backward, and removing the final connection sets the cluster Offline while retaining that heartbeat. The update path also preserves the resource’s expiry.

The local presence suite, focused auth tests, and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated the EOL data for Fedora 37, 38, and 40; added SUSE Enterprise 13 and 14 dates; and marked macOS 11 ended while keeping versions 12–15 present. Extended the Windows 10, Windows 11, and Server 2022 KB mappings in revision order with named struct literals, and updated tests for EOL dates and kernel based KB detection.

Validation passed: `go test ./config ./scanner` and `git diff --check`.

Updated `GUIProcess` so completion messages include the process’s own PID. SIGTERM now produces a `terminated` state and no completion message unless verbose mode is enabled; other signal crashes name the signal.

I updated the existing tests and added SIGTERM coverage. Syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed. The test suite could not start because PyQt5 is missing from this environment.

Worker calls to `display`, `warning`, and `deprecated` now go through `proxy_display`, which sends the method name and exactly the caller-supplied arguments to the main process. The main process invokes the matching method, so warning and deprecation deduplication applies across workers.

The relevant tests passed: 22 passed, 7 skipped.

Updated Ubuntu lifecycle data: 20.04 has extended support through 1 April 2030, and 22.04 is recognised with standard support through 1 April 2027 and extended support through 1 April 2032. I also enabled 22.04 in the Gost CVE lookup path and added regression tests for the dates and support boundaries.

`go test ./config ./gost` passed with network dependency lookup disabled.

Fixed the cancellation expiry date. The [expiry utility](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/subscription/helpers/payment.ts) now uses the active term’s end date and plan name when cancellation context is active or auto-renew is disabled. Cancellation confirmation, redirection, and reminder screens source their dates from it. Free-plan behavior and enabled-renewal behavior remain unchanged.

Verification passed: 37 targeted tests, the components type check, formatting, and `git diff --check`.

Fixed the Kubernetes exec session failure. Kubernetes service now initializes the session uploader before accepting sessions, creating the required upload directories. The forwarder now caches only valid short lived credentials, builds a fresh `clusterSession` for each request, keeps audit recording active after client disconnects, and exposes `ServeHTTP` through its internal router. I also renamed the forwarder configuration fields and updated the TLS heartbeat announcer.

Verification passed: `go test ./lib/kube/proxy ./lib/service` and `git diff --check`.

Centralized storage units in [size.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/helpers/size.ts) and updated storage allocations, CSV imports, organization setup, shared limits, and size formatting to use them. Drive plan initial allocations now use `sizeUnits.TB` as requested.

The CSV import suite passed (64 tests), and formatting and diff checks passed. Type checks for shared and components are blocked by an OpenPGP type mismatch in [packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts:579](/app/packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts:579); neither reported an error in the changed files.

Moved `extra_suffixes_workaround` to module scope in [webview.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py). It returns only additional suffixes for affected Qt versions. `WebEnginePage.chooseFiles` now deduplicates the original and extra suffixes and passes the merged list as the third argument to a single `super().chooseFiles(...)` call on the default path, without using instance state.

Updated the [webview tests](/app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py). All 24 pass with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`; `git diff --check` also passes.

Implemented import preview for `/import` and `/ia_import`. With `preview=true`, the import returns the Edition, Work, and Author records in `edits` with temporary keys, without saving records, uploading covers, or updating Archive.org metadata. Cover host validation is case insensitive; disallowed hosts are rejected.

Updated the author and edition conversion functions and added preview and cover validation tests. The targeted suite passes: **131 tests**. Ruff and `git diff --check` also pass.

InteractiveAuth now supports both stable and unstable registration token stages. The new [token entry view](/app/src/components/views/auth/InteractiveAuthEntryComponents.tsx) provides the required label, help text, focus, busy and error states, and button or Enter submission. It sends the advertised stage type and token; the upper flow adds the session.

The [new tests](/app/test/components/structures/InteractiveAuth-test.tsx) and existing dialog test pass. ESLint and formatting checks pass. The full TypeScript check remains blocked by existing errors in unrelated Sliding Sync files.

Added `checkEventValidity` and `CalendarEventValidity` in [CalendarUtils.ts](/app/src/calendar/date/CalendarUtils.ts). Validation checks invalid dates first, then starts before 1970, then whether the start is strictly before the end. Manual event creation and updates now reject invalid events, and ICS imports reject them instead of repairing invalid end times.

Type checking passed, and the full app test suite passed with 7,988 assertions.

Updated [ansible-galaxy’s install CLI](/app/lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py) so a bare `install -r` processes roles and collections in one run at their configured default paths. Explicit `role` and `collection` installs handle only their own requirements and report skipped items; a bare install with a custom roles path warns that collections were skipped. Empty requirements now produce “Skipping install, no requirements found.”

Added [CLI coverage](/app/test/units/cli/test_galaxy.py) for the mixed and empty requirements cases. All 113 Galaxy CLI unit tests pass.

`BlocklistDownloads` now inherits from `QObject` and emits `single_download_finished(object)` and `all_downloads_finished(int)`. The host and Brave ad blockers connect their handlers before starting downloads, including for empty or immediately completed batches.

Added tests for empty batches, QObject parenting, and multiple listeners. The relevant component suite passed: **39 passed, 13 skipped**.

Updated configuration loading to return `(*config.Result, error)`, with `Config` and `Warnings` as separate fields. Deprecation warnings are collected from keys explicitly present in the configuration file before defaults are applied, including `ui.enabled`. The CLI now logs warnings from the result.

Updated the load tests and added cases for `ui.enabled`, `cache.memory.enabled: false`, and a standalone `cache.memory.expiration`. `go test ./internal/config` and `go test ./cmd/flipt` pass.

Updated the assistant upsell configuration to use the shared `getScribeAddonNameByPlan` resolver. Both paid flows now build a `planIDs` object from the base or selected plan and add a Scribe addon only when one applies. I also exported the resolver and `SelectedPlan` from payments/core and updated their external imports to use that entrypoint.

Added coverage for plans without a Scribe addon. The relevant Jest suites passed: 50 tests. Prettier and `git diff --check` also passed.

Fixed the Qt 6.4 dark mode mapping. A numeric `colors.webpage.darkmode.threshold.text` value now produces `("ForegroundBrightnessThreshold", "100")` on Qt 6.4 and later. Earlier Qt versions retain their existing key.

Added version-specific regression coverage. All 42 dark mode tests pass with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`; `git diff --check` also passes.

Updated the Red Hat family OVAL path to use the locally cached goval dictionary version with resolution data. Advisory IDs are now filtered by distribution, and package fix states flow through to scan results. Gost no longer selects its Red Hat CVE detector.

Added regression tests for advisory IDs, fix states, and package status propagation. Tests passed for `./oval`, `./gost`, `./detector`, `./server`, and `./scanner`; `git diff --check` passed.

Migrated `get_ia.py` to `requests`, including status validation, response content and text handling, UTF-8 fallback, and Range headers. Updated its callers in `marc_subject.py` and the existing tests.

Verification: all 47 tests in `test_get_ia.py` pass, and `git diff --check` passes.

Added unit support to `:later`. It now accepts durations such as `5s`, `2m30s`, and `1.5h`; bare integers still mean milliseconds. The new [parse_duration function](/app/qutebrowser/utils/utils.py) validates input and returns milliseconds, and the [command help](/app/doc/help/commands.asciidoc) reflects the new syntax.

Verification: 255 relevant unit tests passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated the repository so rules accept `segment` as either a string or a `{keys, operator}` object. Import, export, filesystem snapshots, and SQL rule and rollout persistence now handle both forms. Exported rules use the canonical object form, and a single key uses `OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR` regardless of the supplied operator. The requested fixtures and focused tests are included.

Verification passed: `go test ./internal/ext ./internal/storage/fs ./internal/storage/sql` and `git diff --check`.

The admin file upload endpoint now checks that the target folder is an existing directory under the configured upload path before saving. A missing folder or a file used as the folder returns HTTP 500 with `[[error:invalid-path]]`. I added integration tests for both cases.

ESLint and an isolated runtime check passed. The upload integration tests could not reach their assertions because Redis at `127.0.0.1:6379` refused the connection.

Added a reusable [ExternalLink](/app/src/components/views/elements/ExternalLink.tsx) with a decorative icon, a screen-reader new-tab cue, and secure navigation defaults. Settings links now use it, including the hosting-signup link. The Share dialog link has a descriptive accessible name, supported by new localization strings.

The three existing settings test suites, focused ESLint and Stylelint checks, and `git diff --check` pass. The full TypeScript check still reports six errors in unrelated thread files.

Added `guessDateFromText` in [property.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/contacts/property.ts) and wired it into CSV and vCard text date conversion. It parses ISO and common text formats, preserves existing valid dates, and leaves unparseable dates unset. Regression coverage also checks that an imported date serializes to the expected vCard calendar date.

The targeted tests passed (11 specs), along with type checking, ESLint, and Prettier. The full Karma run could not start because its configured Chrome binary is missing.

Implemented the internal token lifecycle interface in [src/api/utils.js](/app/src/api/utils.js). It stores token metadata, maintains the creation, ownership, and last-seen indexes, and supports list, generate, get, update, delete, and usage logging. Newly generated tokens also work with bearer authentication; existing settings-based tokens remain valid.

Added lifecycle and authentication coverage in [test/authentication.js](/app/test/authentication.js). The focused API token tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check` passed.

Added a per-user or guest-session posting lock to topic creation and replies. Overlapping requests now receive HTTP 400 with `status.code: "bad-request"`; the accepted topic request returns 200 with `status.code: "ok"`. The lock is released when processing finishes or fails.

The regression test passed with six concurrent requests: one topic was created, and the category, user, and global topic counters each increased by one. ESLint and `git diff --check` also passed.

Updated [qtargs.py](/app/qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py) so QtWebEngine combines CLI, configured, and required features into one `--enable-features=` argument. QtWebKit arguments remain unchanged. Added coverage in [test_qtargs.py](/app/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py).

Verification: 85 tests passed. One existing Chromium version probe was excluded because it segfaults in this environment’s Qt runtime.

Updated email confirmation handling in [src/user/email.js](/app/src/user/email.js). Pending checks now return strict booleans, `getValidationExpiry` returns the live TTL in milliseconds, and `canSendValidation` applies the configured resend interval. The confirmation marker and record share the configured expiry; explicit expiry clears both.

Added the expiry default and a regression test. Verification passed: 5 email confirmation tests, 6 email API tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Updated [SubscribeCalendarModal.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/calendar/subscribeCalendarModal/SubscribeCalendarModal.tsx) to use the shared 10,000 character URL limit, block invalid or oversized submissions, trim input, and show one warning in the requested priority order. Removed the counter and input length attribute.

Moved ResizeObserver mocks into the components, calendar, and mail Jest setup files and removed the test-local redefinitions. Added [modal tests](/app/packages/components/containers/calendar/subscribeCalendarModal/SubscribeCalendarModal.spec.tsx) with a default-export mock for `useGetCalendarSetup`.

Verification passed: 21 relevant tests, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.

Updated TaskExecutor to resolve `delegate_to` from the current task variables before each execution, including loop iterations. Loop items are evaluated once; the loop cache and duplicate delegation path are removed. VariableManager now provides `get_delegated_vars_and_hostname`, and Task provides `get_play`.

Verification passed: 34 relevant unit tests and the existing random loop, loop caching, and lookup context delegation playbooks.

Post and topic purges now delete uploaded files that have no remaining post references. The Uploads page in the ACP has a **Keep uploaded files on disk after their posts are purged** switch, and `Posts.uploads.deleteFromDisk` supports one path or a list while rejecting invalid input and blocking path traversal.

Verification passed: 342 upload, post, and topic tests; ESLint; and `git diff --check`.

Updated WPScan ingestion to use the first CVE reference as the canonical ID and preserve Enterprise summaries, proof-of-concept and introduced-version metadata, and CVSS metrics. Basic payloads leave optional metadata empty; timestamps are mapped to UTC.

Added tests for enriched, null, and omitted fields. `go test ./detector -count=1` passes.

Added `isShareAvailable(signal, shareId)` to [useDefaultShare.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useDefaultShare.ts). It forwards the signal to `getShare` and returns `false` for locked or soft-deleted shares.

The focused test suite passed: 6 tests, including the existing default-share creation checks.

Added per-server external `nmap` scanning while retaining native scanning when no scanner path is configured. The change includes technique and source port validation, TOML loading, XML result parsing, and a commented `portscan` example in the discovery template.

Relevant tests pass: `go test ./config ./scanner ./subcmds`.

HTTPS support is implemented for the REST API, UI, and gRPC endpoint. Configuration now accepts `server.protocol`, separate HTTP and HTTPS ports, and TLS certificate paths; startup checks HTTPS credentials while existing HTTP configurations keep their defaults.

I updated the configuration docs and added focused tests. `go test ./...` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated the SSH connection plugin to resolve its options through `get_option()`, including command arguments, transfer method, retries, and control path settings. Reset now checks the persistent connection with the effective SSH command before sending `stop`. I also removed the duplicate SSH settings from core configuration and updated the affected tests.

The SSH and PlayContext tests pass: **24 passed**. The broader config manager suite could not complete because an existing fixture assigns `None` to `os.environ['ANSIBLE_CONFIG']` on Python 3.9.

Token creation and deletion are now recognized audit events, including when the configured resource type is `*`. gRPC initialization uses the audit checker to decide whether `token:deleted` is enabled and passes that boolean to the authentication server, so deletion logging follows the configured event list.

Tests for explicit and wildcard token events, and for enabled and disabled deletion logging, pass. The affected Go package tests and `git diff --check` also pass.

Added `qcolor_to_qsscolor` to convert `QColor` values to `rgba(r, g, b, a)` strings, including the default alpha value. The WebView and TabBar background stylesheet templates now use it.

All 123 `qtutils` tests pass. The TabWidget suite stops during setup because its existing icon-size code passes a float to `QSize`; it does not reach the changed color code.

Implemented Best Book Awards in the checked-out repository. Nominations now have persistent storage, read-status and uniqueness validation, add/update/remove and count JSON endpoints, Work accessors, and redirect and account-anonymization integration.

Verification: 50 relevant tests passed, Ruff checks passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Extracted the inline role documentation logic into `RoleMixin._build_doc` in [doc.py](/app/lib/ansible/cli/doc.py:232). It returns `(fqcn, doc)` with the existing document keys, or `(fqcn, None)` when no entry points match. `_create_role_doc` now uses that return value.

Added direct coverage in [test_doc.py](/app/test/units/cli/test_doc.py:37). All 17 tests in that file pass with `PYTHONPATH=/app/lib`; `git diff --check` also passes.

Fixed the module shebang handling in [module_common.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py). New-style Python modules now use their declared interpreter and arguments by default; explicit interpreter overrides still take precedence. Modules without a shebang fall back to `/usr/bin/python`.

Added regression coverage for custom paths, arguments, overrides, and modules without shebangs. All 58 module-common tests passed; the suite emitted two `ZipFile` destructor warnings.

Moved `interpolate_color` and `_get_color_percentage` to [qtutils.py](/app/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py) and updated the download and tab progress indicators to call the new location. The helper now validates percentages for every color space and preserves the start color’s spec when interpolation is disabled.

Moved the interpolation tests to `test_qtutils.py` and added coverage for those edge cases. **All 335 relevant tests passed**, and `git diff --check` passed.

Added a first-class `KEVs` field to vulnerabilities, with CISA and VulnCheck details. Both KEV retrieval paths now populate it, zero due dates become `nil`, and JSON output sorts entries by source and vulnerability name. Added `FormatKEVCveSummary()` and focused tests.

Verified with `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./models ./detector`.

MIME mappings and lossless formats now load during startup from [mime_types.yaml](/app/resources/mime_types.yaml). The loader uses the resource filesystem, so operators can override the bundled file in the data folder’s `resources` directory. The UI reads `mime.LosslessFormats` for its uppercase, comma-separated setting.

The affected tests passed: `./mime`, `./server`, `./model`, and `./core`. The `./cmd` package compiled successfully and has no tests.

Updated the MIME suffix workaround to check **runtime Qt only** at both bounds: 6.2.3 inclusive and 6.7.0 exclusive. I also clarified `version_check`’s `compiled` parameter and made `compiled=True` with `exact=True` raise `RuntimeError`.

The focused tests passed (35). The full affected modules had 197 passes and two unrelated failures under Qt 6.9.1: a QDataStream status count and a QSaveFile warning.

Added `utils.parse_version` using normalized `QVersionNumber` values and updated the Qt checks, distribution version, and crash dialog comparison to use Qt-native versions. The crash dialog shows the update note only when the parsed newest version is strictly greater.

Verification: 345 focused tests passed. The remaining version utility tests had 93 pass, 4 skip, and 1 deselected because its Chromium user-agent probe exits in this environment. `git diff --check` passed.
